ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 input payload application/csv header=true output application/java --- payload

raise-error.description: 請求データに誤りがあるため、取り込みませんでした。

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { runId: vars.runId, rows: sizeOf(payload), results: payload map { billerCode: $.billerCode, payerNumber: $.payerNumber, result: $.result } }

set-variable.value: #[payload.rows ++ ' 行：取込 ' ++ sizeOf(payload.results filter ($.result == '取込')) ++ ' 件']

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var rates = payload.rates default [] --- { provider: payload.provider default "", supported: rates filter (["USD", "EUR"] contains $.currency), skipped: (rates filter !(["USD", "EUR"] contains $.currency)) map $.currency, errors: (if (isEmpty(payload.provider default "") or sizeOf(payload.provider) > 40) [{ line: 0, message: "provider が正しくありません" }] else []) ++ (if (isEmpty(rates) or sizeOf(rates) > 20) [{ line: 0, message: "rates は 1〜20 件で指定してください" }] else []) ++ (rates map (r, i) -> {i: i, r: r} flatMap (x) -> ( (if (!((x.r.mid default "") as String matches /^[0-9]{1,6}(\.[0-9]{1,4})?$/)) [{ line: x.i + 1, message: "mid が正しくありません" }] else []) ++ (if (!((x.r.spread default "") as String matches /^[0-9]{1,4}(\.[0-9]{1,4})?$/)) [{ line: x.i + 1, message: "spread が正しくありません" }] else []) )) }

raise-error.description: 為替相場のデータに誤りがあります。

set-payload.value: #[output application/java --- { currency: payload.currency, ttm: payload.mid as String, spread: payload.spread as String }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { runId: vars.runId, provider: vars.fx.provider, updated: vars.fx.supported map $.currency, skipped: vars.fx.skipped }

set-variable.value: #[vars.fx.provider ++ '：更新 ' ++ ((payload.updated joinBy '・') default '') ++ (if (isEmpty(payload.skipped)) '' else '（対象外 ' ++ (payload.skipped joinBy '・') ++ '）')]
